changes.comment: With `daemon.incrementalBuilds`, the Rush daemon checks whether the input files of an operation that succeeded changed after the inputs snapshot of the build was taken, e.g. because an editor saved a file while the operation ran, whether or not the build cache is enabled. Before, only the build cache checked this, and only for the operations whose results it can write. If a file was edited, added, deleted or replaced while the operation ran, or saved while the snapshot was taken, a later build runs the operation again with its initial script instead of skipping it or building on its outputs incrementally, and its package-deps file is not written.
